description: Bot User-Agent blocked by exchange CDNs
resolution: Use Chrome/125 User-Agent plus full Accept, Sec-Fetch-*, Accept-Language, DNT headers. Set operator-specific Referer to the fee schedule landing page so the CDN treats the request as normal page navigation. 403 should be treated as non-retryable.

description: CBOE landing page is a JS SPA - BeautifulSoup cannot find PDF links in raw HTML
resolution: Do not try to scrape PDF links from CBOE pages. Use the CSV export endpoint instead. The page renders via React and PDF hrefs are not in the server-rendered HTML.

name: Manual file fallback
description: For any exchange that blocks automated downloads: download the PDF manually in a browser, save it to data/raw/<exchange_id>/manual.pdf. The pipeline checks for this file first and skips the HTTP fetch if found.

name: Preflight before real run
description: Always run: python main.py --preflight (or --preflight --exchange <id>) before --run-now. This fetches and parses every endpoint without calling Claude. Shows HTTP status, content size, 8-line preview, CSV row count, and last DB run status. Catches broken URLs before wasting API tokens.
